annotations.title: Is this the same company? (match with evidence)

description:
Decide whether a company you know (an official ID, or a name with a postcode or town) is a company in the official registers, with evidence: candidates each with a decision, linked, possible or rejected, and the reasons.
Use it to match a supplier or customer record to a register record. Don't use it to read a company you already identified: call lookup_company.
Inputs: country FR or ES or GB; name ('Renault', postal_code '92100') and/or identifier (441639465); optional id_scheme, locality, limit (1-10).
Returns: outcome (linked, possible_match, no_match), uncertainty, best, candidates with entity_id, reason codes and evidence.
Limits: 2 units. Only an official ID links: a name, even with an address, is never proof. Read-only, nothing stored.

country.description: ISO country code: FR or ES or GB.
